TUFF-Rib

Metal Roofing and Cladding

Designed for roof slopes above 2/12, Tuff-Rib Metal Roofing & Cladding’s stepped rib design provides strength and good looks as a roofing or wall panel.

Specifications

  • 28 and 26 gauge steel
  • Standard lengths from 4′ to 40′.
  • Comes in a wide choice of attractive colours, Galvanized Plus or Galvalume Plus material
  • Low slope capability to 2/12
  • Architectural design flexibility
  • Purlin bearing leg design makes panel alignment and fastener engagement easy and consistent
